title: Recidivist Insider Trading Defendant Charged With Luxury Watch Scheme And Impersonating A Federal Officer
summary: United States Attorney for the Southern District of New York, Jamie McDonald, and Assistant Director in Charge of the New York Field Office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (“FBI”), James C. Barnacle, Jr., announced today that JOHN AFRIYIE has been charged with wire fraud, impersonating a federal officer, and aggravated identity theft.
